name: Física de Objetos de Fondo
description: Analiza la física de objetos de fondo para detectar inconsistencias de video generado por IA
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Background Object Physics
mechanism:
Este método verifies physical plausibility of background objects in video for deepfake and manipulation detection following Farid (2016):

1. **Object Detección & Seguimiento**: Background objects (furniture, walls, windows, vehicles) are detected and tracked a lo largo de los fotogramas. Their positions, orientations, and visible surfaces are monitored for physical consistency throughout the video sequence.

2. **Perspective Consistencia Verificación**: Object geometry is analyzed for correct linear perspective. Parallel edges should converge at consistente vanishing points across all background objects. Manipulated videos may introduce objects with inconsistente perspective geometry or perspective that shifts inconsistently with camera motion.

3. **Lighting & Sombra Physics**: Shadow directions, ambient occlusion, and specular highlights on background objects are verified for mutual consistency and agreement with the primary light source direction. Composited backgrounds or generado por IA scenes may produce physically impossible shadow configurations.

4. **Temporal Físico Coherencia**: Background objects must obey physical laws — rigid objects maintain shape, occluded objects remain consistente when revealed, and object motion follows Newtonian mechanics. generado por IA backgrounds may produce objects that subtly deform, disappear/reappear inconsistently, or move in physically impossible ways.

5. **Chromatic Aberration & Lente Effects**: Real camera lenses produce consistente chromatic aberration and distortion across the entire field of view. Background objects should exhibit the same optical characteristics as foreground subjects. Composited or generated backgrounds may show inconsistente lens effects, serving as manipulation indicators per Johnson & Farid (2007).
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
